buck.evidence: The Rev A.1 system budget reserves 0.5 A at 3V3 for the ESP32-S3 module and 0.025 A for J4 and remaining low-power loads. The AP63203 application information requires the selected inductor DC current rating to be at least 35% higher than the actual maximum load current.

buck_input_loop_physical_review.rationale: Both input-loop legs were reviewed. The local plane-entry stubs are short and In1 is close, but the two ground vias are not a compact shared return. Moving C4 now would collide with or disturb the validated U3/L1 cluster and require broader rerouting. Validate startup, ripple and load transient on the first prototype.
buck_input_loop_physical_review.template_rule: Evaluate both capacitor terminals and the complete high-di/dt return topology; a short VIN leg alone cannot pass a switch-mode input-loop review.

bulk_mlcc.evidence_limit: Manufacturer curves are typical design-reference data, not guaranteed production minima.

limitations: The 4.7 uH selection intentionally exceeds the AP63203 3.3 V typical-application value of 3.9 uH; validate transient response and startup on the prototype.
Prototype validation must cover buck startup and load transients because the MLCC DC-bias curves are typical rather than guaranteed minima.
Worst-case USB 5 V input current including conversion loss and startup must remain at or below 0.5 A.
This is an electrical selection check, not a thermal release approval.
Validate the assembled converter temperature and selected JLCPCB assembly listing again immediately before manufacture.
